items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, and Benny Fields and Blossom singing. I was in a show called “Star Time.” ... So I learned about show business from them, the vaudeville stuff.

ctx.x: A revue program with chorus girls and dancers, the De Marcos as dancers?
Yes, and Benny Fields and Blossom singing. I was in a show called “Star Time.”
I think this is what leads to “Star Time”—comedians Jerry Lester, Lou Holtz. Tell me about Lou Holtz and how he came into your career.
